title: Composition and identity normalization of the specified shriek product map
statement:
Use the finite-field datum, finite ring $A=A_{E,n}$ and actual constructible operations of [sk-def-sf-operations], on separated finite-type $k$-schemes. For $i=1,2$ let $X_i\xrightarrow{f_i}Y_i\xrightarrow{g_i}S_i$ be separated finite-type morphisms. Put $F=f_1\times_k f_2$, $G=g_1\times_k g_2$, and $h_i=g_if_i$. Write $P_u=Ru_!$, with its specified compact-support composition comparisons. For $B_i\in D^b_{ctf}(X_i,A)$, let
$$t_{f_1,f_2}(B_1,B_2):P_F(B_1\boxtimes B_2)\longrightarrow P_{f_1}B_1\boxtimes P_{f_2}B_2$$
be precisely the $\mathrm{Ku}_!$ isomorphism of [sk-def-sf-kv-maps](i), constructed from the relative product map and the compact-support base-change identifications. Under the specified identifications $P_{GF}=P_GP_F$ and $P_{h_i}=P_{g_i}P_{f_i}$, one has the equality
$$t_{h_1,h_2}(B_1,B_2)=t_{g_1,g_2}(P_{f_1}B_1,P_{f_2}B_2)\circ P_G\bigl(t_{f_1,f_2}(B_1,B_2)\bigr).$$
For $f_i=\operatorname{id}_{X_i}$, the identity comparisons identify $t_{f_1,f_2}(B_1,B_2)$ with $\operatorname{id}_{B_1\boxtimes B_2}$.
